title: Polynomial time from logarithmic word computation
statement: Let $P$ be an extended Word RAM program, let $L$ be a language of Boolean strings, and let $c,C,d\in\mathbb{N}$. Suppose that for every input $x$ there are natural numbers $t,f$ and an output string $o$ such that $t\le C(|x|+1)^d$ and $P$ halts within $t$ steps using words of width $c(\lfloor\log_2 |x|\rfloor+1)$, with output equal to the Boolean indicator of whether $x\in L$. Then $L$ belongs to polynomial time, that is, $L\in\bigcup_{r\in\mathbb{N}}\mathrm{DTIME}(n^r+1)$.
